sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a hall in the makers' foundations under a market city, blue-grey stone blocks older than anything above, a pit full of ancient cable across the floor. On the near side a great makers' receiving dish on a stand, a singing ball resting on its footstone, just splashed and humming, its note drawn as glowing rings going into the dish; on the far landing the dish's twin sends the same rings out over a brass horn, and out of the cable pit tall stone pillars rise into a bridge. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack stands by the near dish, dwarfed by the hall. Faint coloured light from the market's signs through gaps far above. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, blue-grey stone, brass, coral light, teal glints, deep blue shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
